browser_timing_correction.change: Only the QA-owned restart request gets timeout 45000 plus an explanatory comment. No assertion, locator, input or expected business behavior changed.

historical_finding.journey: Revise acquisition evidence and review contribution
historical_finding.expected: A newer UNKNOWN revision of a cost key invalidates that key's older known amount for current contribution; historical as-of queries may retain the earlier evidence.
historical_finding.actual: The January cost 200.01 is still used after a February UNKNOWN revision of the same key. The February summary reports contribution -103.04 and no missing inputs. _cost_evidence_rows filters UNKNOWN rows before choosing the latest version, resurrecting the superseded known row.
historical_finding.business_impact: A seller can receive a qualified profit/loss estimate based on acquisition evidence they explicitly marked unknown.
historical_finding.suggested_fix: Select the latest applicable cost revision first, then preserve UNKNOWN as a blocker; retain valid historical as-of behavior and cost lineage. Implement only with separate remediation authorization.

historical_finding.journey: Retry a stock movement without duplicating or misacknowledging it
historical_finding.expected: Identical retries return the original movement; conflicting delta or intent under the same key produces an explicit conflict rather than success for a different request.
historical_finding.actual: After recording delta 1, reusing the same key with delta 99 returns HTTP 200 and the original balance. Duplicate lookup checks only item/key, not movement identity. No extra stock was added; the defect is silent acceptance of conflicting intent.
historical_finding.business_impact: A seller or retrying client can believe a requested correction succeeded although a different earlier movement was returned.
historical_finding.suggested_fix: Define canonical semantic replay identity and reject changed movement payloads while retaining identical retry and concurrency safety.

historical_finding.journey: Record and safely retry sale/refund evidence
historical_finding.expected: An existing source event ID must not acknowledge materially different monetary evidence as an identical replay.
historical_finding.actual: Replaying the recorded sale with amount 999999 returns HTTP 201/idempotent true and the old event. Both preflight and uniqueness-recovery paths return the existing event without checking amount/type/reference identity. Existing data is not overwritten.
historical_finding.business_impact: Conflicting sale or refund evidence can be silently discarded while a client sees a success response, obscuring reconciliation errors.
historical_finding.suggested_fix: Compare normalized authoritative event identity in both replay paths and return a conflict for changed evidence, without weakening identical-delivery deduplication.

historical_finding.journey: Acknowledge then resolve a signal with traceable HUMAN intent
historical_finding.expected: A resolve request cannot reuse an acknowledge key and receive a successful response for the earlier transition.
historical_finding.actual: A resolve request using the acknowledge key returns HTTP 200, the old transition ID and ACKNOWLEDGED state. _transition looks up owner/key but does not compare signal, target state or note.
historical_finding.business_impact: The displayed/requested HUMAN intent and audit transition may disagree, making operational review unreliable.

evidence.name: Resolve acknowledged as the old transition

historical_finding.suggested_fix: Validate semantic transition scope and target under the canonical owner/key lock; preserve identical concurrent replays.

historical_finding.journey: Replenish stock and refresh operational guidance
historical_finding.expected: A rescan after stock recovery must retire or explicitly stale the obsolete out-of-stock claim; acknowledgement alone does not make old evidence current.
historical_finding.actual: After the same item is replenished from 0 to 20 and rescanned, its signal remains ACKNOWLEDGED/critical with evidence available 0, source version v1 and confidence 0.90. The scan upserts current matches but does not invalidate no-longer-matching signals.
historical_finding.business_impact: A seller may waste time or make unnecessary replenishment decisions from a high-confidence obsolete recommendation. No automatic procurement was executed.
reproduction_steps: Inspect test_15_source_changes_rescan_and_signal_resolution and the preceding stock adjustment.

evidence.name: Old source claim after replenishment and rescan

historical_finding.suggested_fix: Reconcile emitted fingerprints against current source state, retaining history while transitioning obsolete claims to a truthful noncurrent state. Do not auto-approve any business action.

historical_finding.journey: Distinguish rehearsal data from real marketplace evidence
historical_finding.expected: Financial fallback from fake-provider orders remains explicitly synthetic, even when no separate financial event exists.
historical_finding.actual: The Flipkart summary contains only fake orders, canonical_order_fallback true and event_count 0, but synthetic_provider false. The flag inspects FinancialEvent source_type only and ignores fake order totals/provenance. The UI uses this flag to choose Synthetic fixture versus Canonical evidence.
historical_finding.business_impact: A rehearsal can be presented as non-synthetic financial evidence, undermining trust in seller readiness and forecasts.

evidence.name: Fake-order fallback with false synthetic flag

historical_finding.suggested_fix: Propagate synthetic/trust provenance through every contributing canonical source, never promote missing source classification to real/verified evidence.

historical_finding.journey: Resolve and reopen persisted seller work
historical_finding.expected: Selecting Resolved retrieves and displays persisted resolved signals with useful history.
historical_finding.actual: After resolving a card, choosing Resolved shows no card although the detail API reports RESOLVED and history. The select updates ngModel only; load() requests include_resolved only when called later, so the current dataset excludes resolved rows. Reproduced on desktop/mobile.
historical_finding.business_impact: Sellers cannot reliably find completed work through the offered status filter and may think their review history was lost.
reproduction_steps: QA-P3-04: acknowledge and resolve the browser warning, then choose Resolved without another refresh.

evidence.name: Browser screenshots, trace and API proof

historical_finding.suggested_fix: Trigger an authoritative reload on the status change and keep loading/error/context feedback; do not remove the filter or relax the browser assertion.

historical_finding.expected: The seller can distinguish the current page from its broader research section.
historical_finding.actual: In the reviewed 25 October 2026 synthetic desktop screenshot, Business Agent and My Research both use the same active sidebar treatment. The navigation uses prefix matching for the parent /intelligence link. This is a usability recommendation, not an authorization or navigation failure.
historical_finding.suggested_fix: Consider exact matching for the current page or a visually distinct parent-section state. Preserve all routes and access guards.
historical_finding.business_impact: Seller may misinterpret or be unable to complete the recorded operational workflow.
